Headquarters: Austria (remote)

Machine Learning Engineer 

We’re looking for a Machine Learning Engineer with deep expertise in computer vision and biometrics to lead the design and scaling of face recognition systems in production. You’ll build and train models, and own ML systems end-to-end on AWS. The final job level for this role will be determined following the interview process.

What You’ll Do

• Lead the design and development of computer vision systems for biometrics (face attributes, detection, quality, and recognition)

• Rigorous fairness analysis and benchmarking of biometric models across various datasets and operating conditions.

• Architect, train, and optimize models using PyTorch, Tensorflow, and/or JAX

• Own and evolve end-to-end ML pipelines, from data ingestion to deployment. Design automated pipelines (Airflow) for data ingestion and cleaning. You will be responsible for curating balanced training sets and generating synthetic data to address both quality and diversity gaps.

• Production Engineering: Own the path to production. Optimize models for low-latency inference (quantization, distillation, TensorRT/ONNX) and manage deployment on AWS.

• Mentor ML engineers, conduct code/design reviews, and drive technical best practices across the Computer Vision team.

What We’re Looking For

• Experience: Multiple years of industry experience in Machine Learning, with at least 3 years dedicated to Biometrics or Face Analysis.

• Deep expertise in computer vision and biometrics, especially face recognition.

• Fairness & Ethics: You understand the sources of algorithmic bias in Computer Vision and have practical experience measuring and mitigating disparate impact.

• Strong Engineering: Expert proficiency in Python (both machine learning and vision libraries such as Pillow, OpenCV, PyTorch, etc). You write clean, modular, production-ready code.

• Systems Architecture: Experience designing end-to-end ML pipelines (Data to Train to Deploy) and working with workflow orchestrators like Airflow.

• Cloud Native: Hands-on experience scaling training jobs on multi-GPU clusters and deploying services on AWS (SageMaker, EC2, EKS).

Nice to Have

• Research Publications: Papers in CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, or FG related to face recognition, image quality assessment, or fairness.

• Large Scale Search: Experience with vector databases (e.g., Milvus, Faiss) and approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) search algorithms.

• Familiarity with privacy, security, and compliance in biometric systems.

• Mobile/Edge Experience: Experience porting models to edge or mobile devices utilizing frameworks such as CoreML, LiteRT, and/or TFLite.

• Synthetic Data: Experience using GANs or diffusion models to generate synthetic faces for training.

• Strong communication skills.

Jumio Values:

IDEAL: Integrity, Diversity, Empowerment, Accountability, Leading Innovation 

Equal Opportunities: 

Jumio is a collaboration of people with different ideas, strengths, interests and cultures. We welcome applications and colleagues from all backgrounds and of all statuses.

About Jumio:

Jumio is a B2B technology company dedicated to eradicating online identity fraud, money laundering and other financial crimes to help make the internet safer. We leverage AI, biometrics, machine learning, liveness detection and automation to create solutions that are trusted by leading brands worldwide and respected by industry thought leaders. 

Jumio is the leading provider of online identity verification, eKYC and AML solutions. With a global footprint, we’re expanding the team to meet strong client demand across a range of industries including Financial Services, Travel, Sharing Economy, Fintech, Gaming, and others.

Applicant Data Privacy 

We will only use your personal information in connection with Jumio’s application, recruitment, and hiring processes, as described in Jumio’s Applicant Privacy Notice. If you have any questions or comments, please send an email to privacy@jumio.com.

About ElevenLabs
ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.
We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:
• 
ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
• 
ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.
• 
ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.
Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work
• 
High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
• 
Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
• 
AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
• 
Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
• 
Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer
• 
Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
• 
Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
• 
Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
• 
Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
• 
Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.
• 
Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.
About the role
We are looking for a full-stack engineer to help build the next generation of Creative Agents at ElevenLabs.
Our ambition is to make agents a primary way people create across ElevenCreative. We are building systems that turn ideas into high-quality audio, image and video, bringing models and creative tools together without requiring users to become prompting experts.
The creative agent is already live. You will join a small team where engineers own complete problems across the full stack: frontend, backend, agent architecture and infrastructure. You should be equally comfortable building a user-facing feature, designing the services behind it, and deploying and operating the system in production. You will combine strong engineering with product judgement, taking ideas from early prototypes through to reliable features and using real customer feedback to guide what we build next.
Your responsibilities will include:
• 
Designing and building complete agent-powered features, from frontend interfaces and application state to backend services, APIs and data storage.
• 
Developing agent capabilities and integrations, including model orchestration, creative tools and reliable asynchronous workflows for audio, image and video generation.
• 
Building and operating the infrastructure behind these features, improving quality, performance, scalability and security through evaluations, monitoring and testing.
• 
Owning a problem area from discovery and prototyping to deployment and ongoing operation, working closely with product, design and engineering.
You will help shape both what the agent can do and how people use it across ElevenCreative. The work combines substantial greenfield development with improving a live product, with room to experiment and directly influence the product's direction.

Requirements
We care about evidence of exceptional engineering: products you have shipped, difficult problems you have solved, and systems you have owned.
We are looking for:
• 
Strong engineering skills across both frontend and backend, with a track record of independently building complete production applications.
• 
Confidence designing user interfaces, backend services, APIs and data models, and understanding how these components work together as a system.
• 
Practical experience with cloud infrastructure, deployment, asynchronous processing, testing and observability, with the ability to debug and resolve problems across the full stack.
• 
Evidence of end-to-end ownership, strong product judgement and clear communication, taking ambiguous problems from technical design through to shipping and ongoing operation.
You should be excited about creative agents and comfortable learning quickly as models, tools and user needs evolve.
Hands-on experience building production agents, evaluations, MCP integrations, creative editors or multimodal products would be particularly valuable, as would experience building in a small, fast-moving team.
We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

Headquarters: Remote, United States

General Counsel

Remote, United States

Company Overview

Legion Technologies is the pioneer in AI-powered workforce management. Our SaaS platform helps large, distributed enterprises maximize labor efficiency while improving the experience of hourly employees through AI-driven demand forecasting, automated scheduling, time & attendance, and employee engagement tools.(Legion)

Our mission is to transform hourly jobs into good jobs by giving businesses intelligent automation and employees greater flexibility, transparency, and control via an easy-to-use mobile app.(Legion)

Role Summary

The General Counsel (“GC”) is the chief legal officer of Legion Technologies and a key member of the executive leadership team. This role is responsible for:

• Leading Legion’s global legal, intellectual property, and corporate functions

• Serving as a strategic partner to the CEO, executive team, and Board of Directors

• Building and scaling a high-performing legal organization that supports Legion’s next phase of growth, globalization, and product innovation

The GC will own the company’s overall legal strategy across commercial/SaaS, privacy and data protection, AI governance, labor and employment, corporate governance, IP, regulatory compliance, and risk management.(Legion)

Key Responsibilities

1. Legal Strategy & Leadership

• Develop and execute a comprehensive legal strategy that aligns with Legion’s business objectives and growth plans in AI-powered workforce management.

• Advise the CEO, executive team, and Board on key legal, regulatory, and governance matters, including risk, compliance, fundraising, and strategic transactions.

• Build, lead, and mentor a high-performing in-house legal team; manage external counsel efficiently across specialties and jurisdictions.
Establish scalable processes, templates, and playbooks to support rapid go-to-market and partnership execution.

2. Corporate Governance & Financing

• Serve as corporate secretary for Legion Technologies and its subsidiaries; manage all Board and committee governance processes, including agendas, materials, minutes, and consents.

• Oversee corporate structure, subsidiary management, and global entity compliance.

• Support equity and debt financings, including negotiations with investors, diligence, and ongoing compliance with investor rights and governance frameworks.

• Partner with Finance and People teams on equity plan administration, stock option programs, and related disclosures.

3. Commercial, Product & Partnership Counsel

• Own legal support for Legion’s commercial operations, including:

• Enterprise SaaS subscriptions and professional services agreements

• Channel, OEM, marketplace, and strategic partner agreements

• Data processing, DPA, and information security terms

• Work closely with Sales, Customer Success, and Partnerships to enable predictable deal cycles while appropriately managing risk.

• Partner with Product, Engineering, and Security to ensure Legion’s AI-enabled WFM platform, APIs, and integrations with partners (e.g., SAP SuccessFactors and other HR platforms) comply with applicable laws, industry standards, and customer requirements.

• Provide practical, business-oriented product counseling on new features, AI use cases, mobile app capabilities, and international expansion.

4. Privacy, Data Protection & Terms of Use

• Own Legion’s global privacy and data protection program, including compliance with U.S. federal and state laws (e.g., CCPA/CPRA) and international frameworks where applicable.

• Oversee Legion’s Terms of Service, privacy policy, and related product policies, ensuring they remain up to date with evolving regulatory requirements and product capabilities.

• Work with Security and IT to support customer security reviews, audits, and incident response readiness.
Develop and maintain policies and training related to data governance, acceptable use, and ethical AI usage within the platform.

5. Labor, Employment & Workforce Compliance

• Advise on employment matters across Legion’s workforce, including hiring, terminations, performance management, compensation, and incentive programs.

• Support the People team in implementing policies that are compliant with applicable labor laws and consistent with Legion’s mission to improve hourly workers’ experience.

• Provide guidance on product features designed to support customers’ compliance with labor and scheduling laws (e.g., predictable scheduling, good faith estimates, overtime rules), in partnership with Product and Customer Success.

6. Intellectual Property & Innovation

• Develop and implement Legion’s global IP strategy, including patents, trademarks, copyrights, trade secrets, and open-source usage.

• Partner with Product and Engineering to identify and protect innovations related to AI models, algorithms, data pipelines, and workforce management solutions.
Manage enforcement and defense of Legion’s IP rights and respond to third-party claims.

7. Regulatory, Compliance & Risk Management

• Identify and monitor evolving legal and regulatory developments affecting:

• AI and machine learning

• Data privacy and security

• Employment and labor laws

• Enterprise software and cloud services

• Design and oversee a risk and compliance framework that includes policies, training, internal controls, and reporting.

• Support internal investigations and compliance reviews; partner with HR and other functions on ethics and integrity initiatives.

• Coordinate with insurers and brokers on appropriate coverage (e.g., E&O, cyber, D&O) and manage claims as needed.

8. Strategic Transactions & Corporate Development

• Lead legal aspects of M&A, investments, and strategic partnerships, from diligence and transaction negotiation through integration.
Provide structured guidance on competition, antitrust, and other regulatory considerations for strategic deals.

Qualifications

Required

• J.D. degree from an accredited law school and membership in good standing with at least one U.S. state bar.

• 15+ years of combined experience in top-tier law firm and in-house roles, with significant time as General Counsel, Chief Legal Officer, or senior deputy GC at a high-growth technology or SaaS company.

• Deep experience advising on:

• Enterprise SaaS and commercial contracting

• Corporate governance and venture-backed/private equity-backed company issues

• Data privacy and security

• IP strategy and licensing

• Demonstrated track record of building and leading legal teams that support rapid growth and international expansion.

• Proven ability to operate as a business-minded advisor, balancing risk with strategic and commercial objectives.

Preferred Qualification

• Experience in HR tech, workforce management, fintech, or other data-intensive SaaS businesses.

• Prior leadership supporting AI/ML products and associated ethical, regulatory, and data governance issues.

• Experience supporting global customers and operations across North America, EMEA, and APAC.

Prior work with large enterprise and strategic partners (e.g., SAP, other HCM vendors).

Skills & Attributes

• Exceptional judgment, integrity, and discretion; trusted partner to executives and Board.

• Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate complex legal issues into clear, actionable guidance for non-legal stakeholders.

• Highly collaborative, low-ego leadership style with a focus on enabling the business.

• Bias toward practicality and speed; comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

Passion for Legion’s mission to transform hourly jobs and improve the experience of frontline workers.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

• This is a full-time, exempt position.

• Some travel may be required to meet with customers, partners, investors, regulators, and internal teams.

• Legion offers a competitive compensation package including salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. …

  • Advise Senior Manager and above stakeholders on hiring strategy, driving leveling decisions, team composition, and location choices rather than reacting to them.
  • Design and run sourcing strategies across channels and modalities without direction, using competitive intelligence to move passive talent who weren't looking.
  • Make diverse pipelines structural to every search: build them into intake, involve interview panels in sourcing, and evidence the outcome req by req.
  • Bring internal talent and mobility into the conversation with your business partners, treating early-career and internal-promotion paths as real options.
  • Lead a Talent Acquisition initiative that outlasts a single req — candidate experience, interviewer calibration, reporting, or process improvement — and pull the team into it.
  • Set the bar on tools and process: model best practice in the ATS, teach peers, and challenge how we work when there's a better way.

What You'll Bring

  • 6+ years of full life-cycle recruiting, with several years owning senior and leadership hiring for G&A or corporate functions.
  • A record of independently running complex searches to close across more than one function or business unit.
  • Credibility with Senior stakeholders — evidence that your talent recommendations changed a hiring decision, a level, or an org design.
  • Fluency with market and competitive intelligence data, and the judgment to forecast a search with reliable accuracy.
  • Advanced command of an ATS and sourcing stack, at the level where peers come to you for guidance.
  • Persuasive communication under pressure: you can close a senior candidate and reframe a panel's view of a profile in the same week.
  • Deep knowledge of the Indian talent market across cities and functions.

Bonus Points

  • Building or scaling G&A hiring at a public or recently public technology company.
  • Leading a cross-functional TA initiative with measurable results.
  • Partnering with HR and Finance on headcount and location planning.

 

You'll embody Rubrik's RIVET values — Relentlessness, Integrity, Velocity, Excellence, and Transparency — in how you collaborate, make decisions, and show up for Stakeholders and teammates.
